pictures.name: DPH1-Syracuse
pictures.prompt: Ancient Syracuse in Sicily, in the 300s BCE, a white stone city by a deep blue harbor with ships. In a sunny marketplace, Damon, a lean man in his thirties with short dark curls and a trimmed beard, in a plain white wool robe, and Phintias, a stocky man in his thirties with a thick black beard, in a plain undyed wool robe, walk side by side, deep in friendly conversation, one hand on the other’s shoulder. Warm gold light, blue sea. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

Courtiers in rich robes lean in, whispering and smiling slyly. Warm lamplight, deep blue shadows.
